test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

People vary greatly / on the way / they appear and / in their personality traits.
solution:
The correct answer is **On the way. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"On the way"** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct usage is **"In the way" **instead of** "On the way."**
 
• The phrase "in the way" refers to the type of thing being described, thought of, etc.
 
• **We use "on the way" when we talk about the route, direction, or path to somewhere.**
 
• **In the given sentence, we talk about the people's appearance and their personality traits, not about the route or direction.**
 
 
• **Examples:** *There is a very big difference in the way she looked at you today. Her eyes were filled with hatred. *
 
• *We will have our breakfast on the way to Manali. *
 
 

*​*The correct sentence is: **People vary greatly in the way they appear and in their personality traits.**
